source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 1992 official U.S. Senate canvass
source_notes: 1992 regular Arizona U.S. Senate election. County cells and statewide totals transcribed from page 3 of the official canvass issued by the Arizona Secretary of State; every candidate's 15 county cells sum to the printed statewide TOTAL. Cells were read from the printed page images. Named write-ins are included. The canvass PDF was supplied by the project maintainer from the Secretary of State and is retained under data/raw/us-senate/pdfs with its SHA-256 recorded in the snapshots. The Clerk of the U.S. House's Statistics of the Congressional Election of 1992 (Corrected to May 31, 1993) carries the same statewide candidate totals (https://clerk.house.gov/member_info/electionInfo/1992election.pdf); it has no county breakdown.
turnout_definition: Official election-wide ballots cast, eligible registration and turnout percentage as printed on page 1 of the Secretary of State canvass.
